CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.trg_lab_os_biological_only()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND NEW.produto_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.produto_id
    AND NEW.microrganismo_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.microrganismo_id THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  PERFORM platform_private.lab_assert_manufacturable(NEW.produto_id,NEW.microrganismo_id);
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.trg_lab_os_biological_only()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.authz_tickets t WHERE t.txid=txid_current() AND t.scope='b2b_resale_os_create_v1' AND t.target=NEW.id)
   AND platform_private.b2b_resale_os_valid_v1(NEW) IS TRUE THEN RETURN NEW;END IF;
  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND NEW.produto_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.produto_id
    AND NEW.microrganismo_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.microrganismo_id THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  PERFORM platform_private.lab_assert_manufacturable(NEW.produto_id,NEW.microrganismo_id);
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.delivery_confirm_recheck_v1(p_id uuid, p_org uuid)
 RETURNS entregas
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE e public.entregas; BEGIN
 IF platform_private.delivery_confirm_actor_v1() IS DISTINCT FROM p_org THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DELIVERY_CONFIRM_SCOPE_CHANGED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO e FROM public.entregas WHERE id=p_id AND organization_id=p_org;
 IF NOT FOUND OR e.ordem_servico_id IS NULL OR e.partner_order_id IS NOT NULL OR e.ordem_servico_onfarm_id IS NOT NULL OR e.receivable_id IS NOT NULL OR e.os_faturamento_base_id IS NOT NULL
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.ordens_servico o JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id=o.cliente_id WHERE o.id=e.ordem_servico_id AND o.organization_id=p_org AND c.organization_id=p_org AND o.cliente_id=e.cliente_id AND o.origem='agronomica' AND o.partner_order_id IS NULL)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.production_order_link WHERE ordem_servico_id=e.ordem_servico_id)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DELIVERY_CONFIRM_SCOPE_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN e;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.delivery_confirm_recheck_v1(p_id uuid, p_org uuid)
 RETURNS entregas
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE e public.entregas; BEGIN
 IF platform_private.delivery_confirm_actor_v1() IS DISTINCT FROM p_org THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DELIVERY_CONFIRM_SCOPE_CHANGED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO e FROM public.entregas WHERE id=p_id AND organization_id=p_org;
 IF NOT FOUND OR e.ordem_servico_id IS NULL OR e.ordem_servico_onfarm_id IS NOT NULL OR e.receivable_id IS NOT NULL OR e.os_faturamento_base_id IS NOT NULL
 OR (e.partner_order_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.ordens_servico o JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id=o.cliente_id WHERE o.id=e.ordem_servico_id AND o.organization_id=p_org AND c.organization_id=p_org AND o.cliente_id=e.cliente_id AND o.origem='agronomica' AND o.partner_order_id IS NULL))
 OR (e.partner_order_id IS NOT NULL AND platform_private.b2b_resale_delivery_order_valid_v1(e) IS NOT TRUE)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.production_order_link WHERE ordem_servico_id=e.ordem_servico_id)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DELIVERY_CONFIRM_SCOPE_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN e;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.delivery_order_transition_guard_20261030()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.delivery_context_20261030 WHERE txid=pg_catalog.txid_current()) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'DELIVERY_B2B_TRANSITION_CLOSED' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.delivery_order_transition_guard_20261030()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.delivery_context_20261030 WHERE txid=pg_catalog.txid_current())
  AND (TG_TABLE_SCHEMA IS DISTINCT FROM 'public' OR TG_TABLE_NAME IS DISTINCT FROM 'partner_orders' OR platform_private.b2b_resale_delivery_status_transition_valid_v1(OLD,NEW) IS NOT TRUE) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'DELIVERY_B2B_TRANSITION_CLOSED' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
